title: BeamNG.drive
provenance: community report with logs and a screenshot (highball-db#5, Michael-Liendo), unverified by Highball. Second report by imluculent-eng (highball-db#329, 2026-10-05), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 7 minutes: the laptop heats up at once, and generating a seed for story mode fails. Third report by Random-Storm (highball-db#378, 2026-10-07), Apple A18 Pro (MacBook Neo), macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, DXMT, frame cap 60, rated 4 of 5 after 7 minutes, some stuttering (about 25 to 30 fps on low settings, he said on Discord).
notes: Reported playable at 40-60 fps on an Apple M4 with the bottle set to D3DMetal, installed through Steam inside the bottle and launched from Highball. No workarounds, launch options or DLL overrides were needed. BeamNG probes for Direct3D 12, finds no usable device and falls back to Direct3D 11 on its own, so it does not depend on the D3D12-only path. Reported on Highball 0.7.14 with game Alpha v0.39.4, windowed at 1470x934, 6 GB reported to the game as video memory. DXMT is untested on this hardware: the earlier DXMT note came from the DXMT changelog rather than a run. A second, short report on an M5 with DXMT rates it playable, with the laptop heating up at once and story mode unable to generate a seed.

knownIssues.symptom: Story mode cannot generate a seed
knownIssues.cause: reported once (DXMT, M5, engine r19), not diagnosed
